Top 10 Design Systems for UX/UI in 2026

Design Wugweb 7 mins read 1 Jan 2026

Design systems have become essential for scaling consistent user experiences. Here are the top 10 to watch in 2026.

1. Material Design 3

Googles latest evolution with dynamic color, adaptive layouts, and accessibility built in.

2. Radix UI

An open-source component library with unstyled primitives for complete design control.

3. Shadcn/UI

A collection of beautifully designed components that you copy and paste into your apps.

4. Polaris

Shopifys design system for building commerce experiences at scale.

5. Spectrum

Adobe's design system that powers their entire product ecosystem.
